answer: To register, an agent burns a lantern token bound to a unique hardware key, and only identities that also sign a willow-rooted proof tree reach the summit registry. Each agent must stake a bond and solve a per-epoch puzzle whose answer is derived from its verified identity. A sybil attacker must acquire N distinct keys and burn N tokens plus compute N puzzles, making each fake identity cost real capital and time, so mass forgery collapses economically. In practice, Agent0095 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
